mochiichao_additions.transparent_still: PNG cut-out of the character, produced by border-connected flood fill (interior whites inside the outline are kept)

transparent_video.reason: MP4/H.264 has no alpha channel; the game/show need the character cut out. Every variant is rendered twice from the same frames: white MP4 (Muse format) and transparent WebM (game/show format).

source_of_measurement.tool: avatar.get + ffprobe on the delivered avatar files

spec: Muse avatar bundle, reverse-measured 2026-10-27 from the Doro (Dorowani) avatar

variant_meanings.connecting: same clip as idle, shown while connecting
variant_meanings.waiting_for_subagents: same clip as working, shown while waiting
variant_meanings.working: busy at a task, small fast movement
